summary: Build TCFD-aligned disclosures, climate risk registers, and investor-ready reporting in 5 days. Enroll your team now.
lede: TCFD training covers how organizations connect climate risks and opportunities to financially material disclosures. It is for sustainability, risk, finance and reporting professionals who prepare board and investor communications, with practical work on assessing material risks, integrating them into enterprise risk management and drafting disclosure outlines. Learners also explore climate time horizons, Scope 1–3 emissions, baseline definitions and data validation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who must produce TCFD-aligned climate disclosures under regulatory scrutiny and investor pressure.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of financial reporting principles (e.g., IFRS or GAAP basics) and familiarity with ESG concepts. No coding required. Participants should bring a laptop for hands-on exercises using provided Excel templates and AI-assisted data tools. Intermediate to advanced level: suitable for professionals with 2+ years in sustainability, risk, or finance roles.
